help.title: Robot commands
help.command.move_right: Moves the robot one cell to the right.
help.command.move_left: Moves the robot one cell to the left.
help.command.move_up: Moves the robot one cell up.
help.command.move_down: Moves the robot one cell down.
help.command.is_free_left: Returns True if there is no wall on the left.
help.command.is_free_right: Returns True if there is no wall on the right.
help.command.is_free_up: Returns True if there is no wall above.
help.command.is_free_down: Returns True if there is no wall below.
help.command.is_wall_left: Returns True if there is a wall on the left.
help.command.is_wall_right: Returns True if there is a wall on the right.
help.command.is_wall_up: Returns True if there is a wall above.
help.command.is_wall_down: Returns True if there is a wall below.
help.command.is_cell_painted: Returns True if the current cell is painted.
help.command.is_cell_not_painted: Returns True if the current cell is not painted.
help.command.pol: Returns the pollution value of the current cell.
help.command.printn: Prints an integer in the current cell.
help.command.field: Opens a grid of the given size without loading a task file. Robot starts at the top-left; the goal is the bottom-right.
runtime.error.field_integers: field() width and height must be integers
runtime.error.field_width_range: field() width must be between 1 and 20
runtime.error.field_height_range: field() height must be between 1 and 15
